annotations.title: Answer A Number From Your Own Twilio Account

description: Have a voice agent answer calls on ONE number from the business's own connected Twilio account, calls only. Reads only that number. dry_run defaults to true and changes nothing: it returns would_change (the number's VoiceUrl and VoiceMethod) and the fields left unchanged. With dry_run false, only that number's VoiceUrl and VoiceMethod change; its text settings (SmsUrl, SmsMethod, SmsApplicationSid, StatusCallback) are read back afterwards and must be unchanged, so a texting setup another service runs on the account keeps working. Refuses a number a Twilio app answers, and a number another service answers unless replace_existing_voice is true. Uses one plan line. Requires admin role.

agent_id.description: Agent that should answer the calls.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token can access exactly one business).

dry_run.description: Default true: report what would change and write nothing.

phone_number.description: E.164 number on the business's own connected Twilio account.

replace_existing_voice.description: Allow replacing another service that answers calls on this number today.

name: attach_own_twilio_number
